free_parameters.name: batch
free_parameters.why: the target condition reads only q.shape[2]; batch dimension is not used before the decision

free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: the target condition reads only q.shape[2]; head count is not used before the decision

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: head width is not read by the decision; it is only used by dense below the target

free_parameters.name: min_kv_len
free_parameters.why: k/v sequence length only has to be valid for k.size(2); it cannot change q.shape[2]

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: branch depends only on an integer shape; float32 is the CPU-supported default

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed for determinism; tensors are constant so no random value affects the decision

hooks.name: import_time_cpu_shim
hooks.purpose: CPU stand-in for the module-level torch.arange(device='cuda') LAST_Q_MASK constant and empty stubs for GPU-only sibling modules (flash_attn/pycuda/triton kernels) that are imported but never on the path to the target; the target function and its source file are the real repository code
